book.name: Mɛsɔ natelaa Zaŋ ɛ
book.title: Mɛkana mɛ Etɛp e syela Sisim Étɛp natel Zaŋ ɛ Étɛp ɛ Sisim Zaŋ nabee

content: Bhii tak, mɛ eezɛbee fofop ngɔt edus pɛ tɔ gwoo, nyɛ nadi ɛ́ nɛ sap guk na dim-dim di ààbɛ nɛ ɛsik ɛ nɛ boo kel ghwooz e mbɔ.
Nyɛ eezɛmɛt dhalaghɔŋ, nyɔ na mwa, ye kwyɛl ɛlɛɛ dim mot mɛkɔŋ nɛghu Satan. Wɔ gwaa, nyɛ zɛkɔl nyɛ, lo nyɛ é mbok pɛ nyɛ aakɛdi membu mil wat ɛ.

Bhis fofop nalóo nyɛ tɔ guk na dim-dim di ààbɛ nɛ ɛsik ɛ, nyɛ eezɛkɔɔl yɛ nɛ sap, nyɛ eezɛtiŋal boo ɛtuŋa pɛ ɛko tak, kɛl luk etɛɛ náá, dhalaghɔŋ needi ààbaasuu ɛsa náá, bot ɛ mɛdhik wo ze, kɛkum é ghɛŋ membu mil menek aadjaala ɛ. Bhii tak, nyɛ waawyiselaa étɛp ba mɔɔ ɛwala.

Bhii tak, mɛ eezɛbee mɛbhóó bɛghɛŋ, bot ɛ nadi mendiidel kɔ tak ɔ naabela ghwyil ɛpɛ́ɛ ɛ bot. Mɛ naabaabee esisim ɛ bot ɛ natsaakaa kɔ ɛsu ɛ esosoob bɔɔ dum nɛ etsɛɛtsɛ Yezu natel nɛ bɛngoolel ɛ mɛkpa ɛ Zɛɛb nɛ mɛkpa ɛ Zɛɛb. Bot binɔk nabɛ ɛ́ ààduwal tit nɛ naghisɛ yɛ, bɛ nabɛ ɛ́ ààbela geka tit kɔ ebhata-bhwoob, ààkobɛ-bɛak é mbɔ. Bɛ naabela tsik, nɛ ɛkɔk sama nɛ Klisto membu mil wat.
Bɛdhiiti bot ɛ nagwyɛ ɔ, nabɛ ɛ́ ààbula e tsik ɛsok nɛ membu mil wat yenek nɛ si. Ye ɛ́ ɛgom ɛ bot goma mɛkɛn.
Mɛmyaala nɛ bot ɛ Zɛɛb nagom é ɛgom ɛ mɛkɛn ɔ. Tin, ɛsyee ɛ bhɔɔba tokapɛ nɛ ghwyil kɔ lɔɔ. Deenek, bɛ kadi ɛ́ bɛghaa-Zɛɛb e Zɛɛb nɛ yii ɛ Klisto, bɛ aakɔk sama nɛ Klisto membu mil wat.
É ghɛŋ membu mil wat (1 000) yenek aadjala ɛ, Satan aawyiselaa é mbok,
nyɛ waatɔ́ kɛkɔɔ bot ɛ mɛdhik djas di kɔ etuma ená e bɔs ɔ, ye kwyɛl ɛlɛɛ Ghɔɔg nɛ Maghoogh
. Nyɛ aasɛɛg bɛ étɛp ɛduu tuub. Bɛ aadi ɛ́ ɛbuɛpe dáa bɛsyɛ engwoob boo dii mɛsɔn.
Bɛ eezɛwyɛza kɔ ɛko ɛ bɔs djas ɛ. Bɛ eezekii sum di bot ɛ mbyak Zɛɛb boma, ghaada Zɛɛb di ekwyɛl ɛ. Tin, du ɛzɛdus pɛ tɔ gwoo, bhis tak yɛ eezɛdik bɛ.
Wɔ gwaa, dim mot mɛkɔŋ, mot nadi ekɔɔ bɛ ɔ, eezemwasaa tɔ tok du mɛsii na goo-goo pɛ kyee tit nɛ embee bɛngoolel ɛ mɛkpa ɛ Zɛɛb bɛ di ɔ. Deenek, bɛ aadi zukaa mwos nɛ pum kɔm-kɔm.
Bhii tak, mɛ eezɛbee boo bóó bɛghɛŋ na puu, nɛ mot ndiidel kɔ tak. Gwoo nɛ bɔs naazɛdiib sok bhwoob'ɛ, mot nabɛ ɛ́ ààkabaabee bɛ.

Bhii tak, mɛ eezɛbee bot ɛ nazegwyɛ ɔ, bot di nɛ mbyok nɛ bot ɛ ààdi nɛ mbyok nabɛ ɛ́ titel sok bóó bɛghɛŋ. Tin, bɛmɛkana naazɛdiiaa, wɔ gwaa, dhiiti mɛkana zɛbaadiiaa, yenek nabɛ ɛ́ mɛkana mɛ tsik. Bot nazegwyɛ ɔ, napɛ́ɛaa ɛ dum nɛ sa bɛ nasa ɛ, dáa yɛ nazekwyalaa tɔ bɛmɛkana ɛ.
Boo dii mɛsɔn naazɛbulal bot ɛ nagwyɛ tɔ tak ɔ, wɔ gwaa, ɛsyee nɛ zula bot ɛ nazegwyɛ ɔ, zɛbulal yɔɔ pe. Deenek, mot nɛ mot naapɛ́ɛaa dum nɛ sa nyɛ nasa ɛ.
Tin, ɛsyee nɛ zula bot ɛ zegwyɛ ɔ, zokazɛmwasaa tɔ tok du. Tok du tak ɛ́ ɛsyee bhɔɔba.
Deenek, mot djas nadi ààbɛ nɛ din kwyala tɔ mɛkana mɛ tsik ɔ, naamwasaa tɔ tok du.

footnotes.text: Ghɔɔg nɛ Maghoogh Ye ɛ́ deenek ɛ bot ɛ mbyak eYuda nadi edje-djóo ekyee mɛdhik mɛ bot ɛ mɛbhuka ɛ bɔn ɛ Zɛɛb é mɛsik mɛ bhwak. Ye aabelaa ɛ tɔ Ɛze 38—39.
